title: Coastal Communities Wellbeing Study
plainLanguageSummary: A fictional study exploring how coastal change affects community wellbeing and access to local services.
objectives: Demonstrate an ethical, human-participant research workflow using entirely synthetic project information.
methods: Synthetic interviews and an anonymous online survey with adult volunteers; no real participant data is used in this demonstration.

title: Open Weather Sensor Evaluation
plainLanguageSummary: A non-sensitive fictional evaluation of environmental sensor accuracy using generated observations.
objectives: Compare repeatability and calibration drift across a synthetic sensor fleet.
methods: Generate simulated readings, calculate aggregate error metrics, and publish the evaluation scripts.
